ogDescription:
Victor Verma & Greater Wyndham Realtors proudly present 128 Bondi Parade, Point Cook.

An impeccably designed double-storey family residence, perfectly positioned in the heart of Point Cook. Thoughtfully crafted with a distinctive floor plan, this exceptional home offers multiple living zones, providing the ideal balance of comfort, functionality, and contemporary family living. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Saltwater Coast, this exceptional residence offers a warm and welcoming family lifestyle in one of Point Cook's most sought-after coastal communities. Families will appreciate the convenience of being within walking distance of Saltwater P-9 College and St Mary of the Cross Catholic Primary School, with the home also zoned for Homestead Senior Secondary College. Surrounded by beautiful parks, tranquil wetlands, scenic walking trails and sporting grounds, the location provides everything you need to enjoy an active and connected lifestyle.

Exception double story homes offer:

Downstairs: -

# Dedicated study room
# A magnificent, generously proportioned lounge area offers an inviting space for the whole family to relax, unwind and entertain in comfort
# A stunning designer kitchen combines style, functionality and everyday practicality, featuring elegant stone benchtops and an abundance of workspace
# A beautifully appointed separate dining area provides the perfect space to gather for dining
# A spacious living area seamlessly adjoins the designer kitchen, creating a warm and connected heart of the home. Perfect for relaxed family living and effortless entertaining, this inviting space allows everyone to stay connected while enjoying the comfort and convenience of a beautifully designed open-plan layout
# An impressive alfresco area provides the perfect setting for effortless outdoor entertaining and relaxed family gatherings
# Double car garage with internal access
# Spacious laundry
# Downstairs powder room for guests

Upstairs:
# Four well-sized bedrooms including a luxurious master suite with a private balcony, huge walk-in robe, and double vanity ensuite with an oversized shower
# The remaining three spacious bedrooms are thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and privacy, each featuring built-in robes for excellent storage. Generously sized and filled with natural light
# Upstairs retreat- spacious and versatile, this impressive second living area can be styled as a family lounge, children's retreat, media space or quiet zone for relaxation
# A centrally located family bathroom offers convenience and functionality for the entire household, complemented by a separate toilet for added practicality

Extra features: - Timber Floorboards, Ducted Heating, Evaporative Cooling, High Ceilings and much more.
Meticulously crafted and lovingly maintained, this remarkable residence presents a rare opportunity to secure a luxurious family home in one of Point Cook's premier coastal settings.

For more information or to arrange your private inspection, contact Victor on 0430 301 437 today.

title: 21 Tackle Drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Perfectly positioned within the sought-after Saratoga Estate in Point Cook, 21 Tackle Drive presents an exciting opportunity for families, first-home buyers, downsizers and savvy investors looking for a modern, low-maintenance home in a well-connected and family-friendly community.

Offering four generous bedrooms, two bathrooms and secure double-car accommodation, this thoughtfully designed residence combines comfortable living spaces with the convenience of a low-maintenance lifestyle.

At the centre of the home is a welcoming living and dining area, creating a versatile space for everyday family life, entertaining guests or simply relaxing at the end of the day. The well-proportioned bedrooms provide excellent flexibility for families, guests, children or those requiring a dedicated home office or study space.

Live the Saratoga Estate Lifestyle
One of the property's standout advantages is its location within Saratoga Estate, Point Cook - a popular residential community known for its family-oriented environment, landscaped surroundings and convenient access to everyday amenities.

Residents can enjoy a lifestyle surrounded by established streetscapes, parks, open spaces and family-friendly facilities, while still being within easy reach of Point Cook's extensive shopping, dining, education and recreational offerings.

Adding further convenience is the Sprinkles Ice Cream Shop located at the front of the Saratoga Estate, providing a much-loved local destination for families and residents to enjoy a treat close to home. This is the kind of small lifestyle convenience that adds to the appeal and community feel of the estate.

Education & Family Convenience
Families will appreciate the property's position within the Featherbrook P-9 College school zone, with Point Cook Senior Secondary College also servicing the area.

The location provides convenient access to a range of schools, childcare facilities, parks, sporting grounds, shopping centres, cafés and public transport options, making everyday living exceptionally convenient.

A Smart Choice for Homeowners or Investors
Whether you're looking to establish your family in Point Cook, purchase your first home or add a quality property to your investment portfolio, 21 Tackle Drive offers an appealing combination of space, functionality, location and low-maintenance living.

With four bedrooms, two bathrooms and double-car accommodation, the home provides the flexibility modern families demand, while its position within Saratoga Estate adds an additional lifestyle advantage.

Property Highlights
• Four spacious bedrooms
• Two bathrooms
• Double-car accommodation
• Approx. 171m² landholding
• Low-maintenance townhouse lifestyle

• Close to parks, schools, shopping, dining and public transport
• Ideal for families, first-home buyers, downsizers and investors

Offering a combination of modern living, low-maintenance convenience and an enviable Saratoga Estate location, 21 Tackle Drive is an opportunity not to be missed. Come and experience the lifestyle and convenience this Point Cook property has to offer.

title: 29 tackle drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - Townhouse for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Offered to the market for the very first time, this beautifully maintained owner-occupied townhouse presents a rare opportunity to secure a home that has been lovingly cared for since new. Never tenanted and meticulously maintained, it offers the peace of mind that only a genuine first-hand owner can provide.

Positioned on a desirable corner block, this home enjoys significantly more natural light and privacy than typical townhouses situated between neighbouring properties. Large windows throughout fill the living spaces and bedrooms with sunshine, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere all year round.

Designed with flexibility in mind, the spacious floorplan offers four generous bedrooms, allowing you to easily accommodate a growing family, create a dedicated home office, or set up a guest room to suit your lifestyle. The well-appointed layout also features two modern bathrooms, multiple living zones, and a secure double garage.

As a resident, you'll enjoy exclusive access to a private residents' clubhouse, offering resort-style amenities including a modern, fully equipped gym, a heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, and beautifully maintained communal facilities. title: 9 Butchart Close, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Perfectly designed for modern family living, this beautifully appointed four-bedroom home offers an exceptional balance of space, comfort, and functionality in one of Point Cook's peaceful residential pockets. Set on approximately 392m², the home presents an ideal opportunity for growing families, first-home buyers, or savvy investors seeking a quality property in a thriving community.

Step inside to discover a thoughtfully designed floorplan featuring a light-filled open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area at the heart of the home. The well-equipped kitchen overlooks the main living space, making everyday living and entertaining effortless, while a separate family room and an enclosed outdoor room provide additional flexibility for relaxing, hosting guests, or creating a children's retreat.

The generous master bedroom is positioned at the front of the home and features a walk-in robe and private ensuite. Three additional bedrooms are serviced by a central bathroom, offering ample accommodation for the whole family. A full-sized laundry, abundant storage throughout, and a double remote garage with internal access further enhance the home's practicality.

Conveniently located close to schools, parks, shopping centres, public transport, and all the lifestyle amenities Point Cook is renowned for, this is a fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious family home in a highly sought-after neighbourhood. Whether you're looking to move straight in or invest for the future, 9 Butchart Close delivers comfort, convenience, and outstanding family appeal.
